transcript: "At the start of Klasse 10 I wrote in three modes: translated, formal, and imitating others. By Christmas I had started a fourth mode I'd call paying attention. The piece I'm proudest of is Late Bus, Cold Bench. By the end of Oberstufe I will have written 30 to 50 longer essays. I am taking Englisch as a Leistungsfach."
